messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

High-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow includes insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation [4].
R&S PCB test solutions include material measurement with TDR impedance and DK/DF extraction [21].
R&S PCB test solutions include material/stackup selection using IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, crosstalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram [21].
R&S PCB test solutions include signal-integrity modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [21].
R&S PCB test solutions include sampling testing with IL, DK/DF, and impedance [21].
R&S PCB test solutions include process-monitoring context for IL, DK/DF, and impedance [21].
Wireless communication applications in the knowledge base include Wi‑Fi 7 specifications such as 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096-QAM, MLO, 6 GHz band, and thermal throttling [15].
Wireless communication applications in the knowledge base also include LEO satellite supply-chain topics involving high-frequency PCB, RF components, phased-array antennas, user terminals, system integration, and test validation [17].
Wireless certification applications include Starlink / Project Kuiper user terminal RF validation, phased-array antenna beamforming tests, and mmWave / MIMO high-frequency test capability [62].
【推論】For Wireless Communication hardware, the supported SI priorities are PCB material characterization, impedance control, loss and crosstalk validation, eye-diagram verification, stackup/transmission-line modeling, and production/process monitoring, because the RS SI flow and PCB test solution list those capabilities while the wireless passages name high-bandwidth Wi‑Fi 7, high-frequency PCB, RF front-end, phased-array, mmWave, and MIMO application contexts [4][15][17][21][62].

無線通訊認證實驗室 › 重點摘要
本來源是由 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 轉出的 company restricted 簡報，正式發布日期與文件版次未標示；raw frontmatter 顯示 converted 日期為 2026-09-17。

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

主要內容包括：

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 來源稱認證必要性包括防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端與 6G 等需求。
- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。
